name: main
_comment: Applied via `gh api -X PUT repos/Adam-S-Daniel/adamdaniel.ai/rulesets/13985217 --input .github/rulesets/main.json` — checked in here so the rule is reviewable in the repo. POST-CUTOVER (cms-platform consumer): the CI machinery now lives in cms-platform's reusable workflows, called from thin callers in .github/workflows/. A reusable called from a caller job named X surfaces its check as `X / <reusable-job>`, so every required context below is the COMBINED `<caller-job-id> / <reusable-job-id>` name (NOT the bare reusable job name). Derivation, one per context: `editorial / validate-content` — caller cms-editorial-workflow.yml job `editorial` -> reusable cms-editorial-workflow.yml job `validate-content` (no caller paths filter, validate-content has no job-level `if:`, so it always fires on every PR; the reusable's other job `auto-merge-when-ready` is conditional and is deliberately NOT required). `scan / scan` — caller secrets-scan.yml job `scan` -> reusable secrets-scan.yml job `scan` (caller pull_request has no paths filter, always fires). `parity / parity` — caller parity-preview.yml job `parity` -> reusable parity-preview.yml job `parity` (no caller paths filter; always-run + early-skip inside the reusable reports success when no @parity-preview spec applies). `preview-media / preview-media` — caller preview-media.yml job `preview-media` -> reusable preview-media.yml job `preview-media` (no caller paths filter; always-run + early-skip; HARD-FAILS only when a media-salient PR's preview-pr<N> surface is unreachable, which is the trap-safe way to require deploy-preview for media PRs without making the path-filtered deploy-preview.yml a required context). `e2e / e2e` — caller e2e-tests.yml job `e2e` -> reusable e2e-tests.yml single job `e2e` (the heavy local lane: real jekyll build + decap-server + the FULL Playwright matrix incl. @admin-write round-trips, with `browser: all` + prod_playground_mode wired from PROD_PLAYGROUND_MODE). This single `e2e` check REPLACES the old monolithic-workflow contexts `select` / `unit` / `e2e (1)` / `e2e-admin` / `finalize` — the platform reusable runs the whole Playwright project matrix inside one workflow-call job, so there is exactly one surfaced check. The caller keeps `paths-ignore`, so `e2e / e2e` may not appear on truly doc-only PRs — when that happens branch protection blocks the merge as designed (same behaviour the old e2e contexts had); the owner can override or expand the PR with a small site change. `visual-regression / approve-regression` — caller visual-regression.yml job `visual-regression` -> reusable visual-regression.yml gate job `approve-regression` (no caller paths filter; the gate runs `if: always()` and enters the `regression-review` environment ONLY when the build found visually-different pages, otherwise it auto-passes — so it ALWAYS reports a status and is trap-safe to require, unlike the path-filtered deploy-preview it used to share an exclusion with). NOTE: these combined `caller / reusable` names are DERIVED from the caller+reusable job ids at pinned platform ref 3e683fee855f6dd49553adb634e02b4365388da3; the LIVE GitHub ruleset (id 13985217) must be updated to match — the orchestrator should confirm the exact rendered context strings on the first PR run (GitHub may render the separator with surrounding spaces as `X / Y`) and `gh api -X PUT` this file. The cms-automerge-nudge.yml caller's `required_contexts` input mirrors this exact list. Dropped vs. the pre-cutover ruleset: `prod-mutate` / `host-loop` / `deploy-preview` remain excluded (path-filtered = missing-check trap); `approve-regression` was formerly excluded for the same reason but is now REQUIRED as `visual-regression / approve-regression` — its caller has no paths filter and the gate runs `if: always()`, so it always reports; the old `select` / `unit` / `e2e (1)` / `e2e-admin` / `finalize` collapse into `e2e / e2e`; required-check-stubs.yml is deleted because the stub contexts no longer exist under the new topology.
